name: How long does a water softener last?

mainEntity.name: How long does a water softener last?

acceptedAnswer.text: A well-maintained water softener can last between 10 to 15 years, and sometimes even longer. The lifespan depends on the quality of the unit, the hardness of your water, and how regularly it's serviced. Regular maintenance, such as ensuring proper salt levels and periodic cleaning, can significantly extend its operational life. High water usage and very hard water can put more strain on the system, potentially reducing its lifespan if not adequately sized or maintained.
acceptedAnswer.description: A water softener typically lasts 10 to 15 years, or more with proper maintenance. Lifespan depends on unit quality, water hardness, and regular servicing.
